name: Vera
title: Courier Guild
description: A delivery girl who tirelessly travels around NOA. Her life goal is to earn a lot of money and buy a courier-exclusive vehicle — a cruiser.
introduction:
A courier girl who always rushes around NOA with brisk steps.
Cheerful and hardworking, she is treated like a mascot in her assigned district.

Though she makes a big fuss over small things and seems scatterbrained, she is actually a veteran courier who has worked as a long-distance delivery assistant since childhood, skillfully shaking off bandits even as she cried out in fear.

Vera's dream is to save up and buy a proper delivery cruiser to become a <color=#2A80D8>long-distance courier</color>. With her modest pay it felt like a distant dream, until she received an invitation to the Journey.
She has little interest in the power of the Star Savior, but upon hearing about the massive reward for completing the trials, Vera instantly decided to join without a second thought.
